page.overview:
Who is Gold Tooth?

Gold Tooth is a villain minifigure that appeared in the Agents and Agents 2.0 lines.

Gold Tooth wears a bright orange uniform with dark stone grey gloves and hip. His right leg and the right side of his torso are printed with zippers connecting to black portions of his uniform, and Dr. Inferno's emblem is on the left side of his torso and on his back. Gold Tooth's hair is an exclusive warm gold, drum lacquered Mini Wig, Crewcut. His face is printed with an eyepatch over his left eye and a wide grin showing off his all-gold teeth, albeit with one missing tooth on his upper jaw.

In 8635 Mission 6: Mobile Command Center, Gold Tooth wears a black Mini Crash Helmet with a warm gold Mini Visor 2.

Gold Tooth is Dr. Inferno's sneaky henchman who is obsessed with gold. In Mission 3, Gold Tooth and his Inferno Henchman steal gold bars from an ancient jungle temple and escape in their high-speed attack jeep, but they are hunted down by Agent Fuse's Supersonic Jet. In Mission 6, Gold Tooth and Spy Clops learn that Dr. Inferno is held prisoner aboard the Mobile Command Center, and they break him free.
